description: Create a session: a persistent browser identity (cookie jar, localStorage, a fixed rendering tier and, by default, a sticky exit IP) that survives across scrapes. Use it for multi-step flows — log in, then fetch pages behind the login — by passing the returned `id` as `session_id` to every `spicrawl_scrape` call that should share the state. The rendering tier is fixed for the session's lifetime and every scrape on the session runs on it. Leave `engine` out and one is chosen for you. Release the session with `spicrawl_session_release` when done. Returns the session object (id, engine, status, sticky_key, proxy, expires_at).

domain_scores.description: Seed per-domain error scores (usually copied from a spicrawl_session_context dump).

engine.description: Rendering tier fixed for the session's lifetime. Optional: leave it out and one is chosen for you. `fetch` is plain HTTP; `js` is JavaScript rendering and refuses `actions`, `block_resources`, screenshots and PDFs; `browser` is a full browser.

session_context.description: Seed the session's state (cookies, storage) — e.g. the `session_context` object from spicrawl_session_context, to clone a session.

ttl_seconds.description: Idle lifetime in seconds (min 30, default 1800; the organization's maximum is enforced, not clamped).

name: spicrawl_session_create

bytes.description: Serialised size of the stored context.

origins.description: Distinct origins with stored web storage.

context.description: Size summary of the stored context (counts only, no secrets); null once the session is not active.

retired.description: Hard block for this domain; use a new session for it.

score.description: Error score; rises on failures, decays on successes. Blocked at 3.

domain_scores.description: Per-domain standing, keyed by domain. Omitted when empty.

engine.description: Rendering tier the session is bound to: fetch, js or browser.

expires_at.description: Current expiry (slides on use), RFC 3339 UTC.

hard_expires_at.description: Fixed ceiling the expiry never passes, RFC 3339 UTC.

id.description: Session id; pass it as `session_id` to spicrawl_scrape.

last_used_at.description: Last successful scrape, RFC 3339 UTC; null if never used.

lease.description: Present only while a scrape holds the session; release and delete are refused until it lapses unless `force`.

expires_at.description: When the lease lapses at the latest, RFC 3339 UTC.

proxy.description: The session's exit intent (never an IP or endpoint).

country.description: Lowercase alpha-2 exit country, when one was requested.

released_at.description: Release time, on released sessions, RFC 3339 UTC.

retired.description: Why the session was taken out of service (expired, usage_exhausted, explicit); absent while usable.

status.description: active, released or expired; derived from the clock, and only `active` sessions can be used.

sticky_key.description: Exit pin in use (empty when rotate_ip was set).

usage_count.description: Successful scrapes that used the session.

warnings.description: Decisions made on your behalf at creation, e.g. a TTL reduced to the organization maximum.

title: Create a browsing session
